name: Homemade Crunchwrap Supreme
desc: Taco beef, nacho cheese, a tostada shell, and cold fixings folded into a flour tortilla and crisped in a skillet.

source.title: Homemade Crunch Wrap Supreme
source.evidence: Same build and list: 1 lb ground beef with a packet of taco seasoning, large flour tortillas, warmed nacho cheese, tostada shells, sour cream, shredded lettuce, tomato and Mexican-blend cheese, folded and seared seam side down.

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup water (or the amount on your seasoning packet)
ingredients.note: or the amount on your seasoning packet

steps: Cook the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until browned with no pink left, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer on low until the sauce thickens and coats the meat, 5 to 7 minutes.
Warm the nacho cheese in the microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring between. Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave until pliable, about 30 seconds.
In the center of each tortilla, spread a spoonful of nacho cheese and add about 1/3 cup beef. Set a tostada shell on top, spread with sour cream, and top with lettuce, tomato, and shredded cheese.
Fold the tortilla edges up over the center in overlapping pleats, working all the way around, to close it into a hexagon.
Coat a skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. Cook each crunchwrap seam side down first, 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown. Serve hot.
tips: If the tortilla will not close over the top, cover the gap with a small taco-size tortilla before folding the edges over it.

references.title: Homemade Crunch Wrap Supreme
references.usedFor: fold and sear method, seam side down first
